== deviceConnect Console

- The device list and the device details page now show how many errors each device had in the last hour, for example *3 errors in the last hour*. Devices with no errors in the last hour show no error line.
- An error is an unexpected USB disconnect, where an online device goes offline outside a Return-to-Service wipe, or a device health check that changes from passing to failing. A health check that stays failing counts once.
- When a device has more than 10 errors in the last hour, the error line turns orange and links to the offline devices troubleshooting guide. The warning clears when the hourly count drops to 10 or fewer.
- Error counts reset to 0 when deviceConnect services restart.
